question: Who was the first Indian to get the Oscar for lifetime achievements in cinema in 1992?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Satyajit Ray.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Satyajit Ray:-**

 
 
• Satyajit Ray (1921-1992) was a renowned Indian filmmaker, screenwriter, author, and composer.
 
• He is considered one of the greatest filmmakers in the history of cinema and is often credited with bringing Indian cinema to the global stage.
 
• Ray is particularly known for his realistic and artistic approach to filmmaking, focusing on human relationships and social issues.
 
• Ray's directorial debut came with the film "Pather Panchali" (1955), the first installment of his critically acclaimed Apu Trilogy.
 
 
• The trilogy, which also includes "Aparajito" (1956) and "Apur Sansar" (1959), follows the life of a young boy named Apu and is considered a masterpiece of world cinema.
 
 
 
• Satyajit Ray received numerous awards and accolades throughout his career:-
 
 
• He was honored with the prestigious Legion of Honour by the French government, and in 1992.
 
• He was posthumously awarded the Academy Award for Lifetime Achievement.
 
 
 
 
 
• **The Academy Awards:-**
 
 
• They are also known as the Oscars, are an annual set of awards honoring artistic and technical excellence in the film industry.
 
• The awards are presented by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (AMPAS), and they recognize outstanding achievements in various categories, including acting, directing, writing, and film production.

• ** Tarun Majumdar:-**

 
 
• Tarun Majumdar is an Indian film director and screenwriter known for his work in Bengali cinema.
 
• He was born on February 22, 1931, in Comilla, British India (now Bangladesh).
 
• Majumdar is considered one of the pioneers of the parallel cinema movement in Bengal and is often associated with the "middle cinema" genre.
 
 
 
• **K Viswanath:-**
 
 
• ​Kasinathuni Viswanath, popularly known as K. Viswanath, is an eminent Indian film director, screenwriter, and actor, primarily associated with Telugu cinema.
 
• He was born on February 19, 1930, in Repalle, Andhra Pradesh, India.
 
• Viswanath is known for his artistic and socially relevant films, which have garnered critical acclaim and widespread recognition.
 
 
 
• **T. Rama Rao:-**
 
 
• Nandamuri Taraka Rama Rao (NTR), was a prominent Indian actor, filmmaker, and politician.
 
• He was born on May 28, 1923, in Nimmakuru, Andhra Pradesh, India, and passed away on January 18, 1996.
 
• NTR had a remarkable career in the Telugu film industry, where he acted in over 300 films and gained immense popularity.
 
• He made his acting debut in 1949 with the film "Mana Desam" and went on to portray a wide range of roles, including mythological, historical, and social dramas
